text_block_list.text: (Screeech...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hakodate, arriiived☆
So, wanna hit up some sightseeing before the race and get our vibes up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hakodate... I've been here many times,
but I don't think I've ever taken the time to do proper sightseeing!
And so, we decided to first have some fun and get our spirits up.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fish market, whooooopâ
Fresh catch vibes, let's goooâª

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer,
they're selling crab! Crab!

Snow crab is in season during winter, but Hokkaido in summer offered a different kind of crab.
After eating our fill, we climbed up to the heights overlooking the city—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This view is insane☆ Alright, line up, line up~!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's true! Come to think of it, that was a total blind spot.
We could've just hung out and had fun
in Hakodate like this..."
choice_data_list: Why haven't you ever played around until now?
Why didn't you ever play before?

text_block_list.text:
Curious, I decide to ask.
Coming all the way to one of Hokkaido's top tourist cities
and not doing any sightseeing would be unusual, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The reason is—the view from this hill!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Can you see it?
Look, that mountain towering in the distance.

Looking behind Mejiro Palmer,
there was a gigantic mountain. That mountain was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Mount Yotei. At its base lies the Mejiro estate. Which means this Hakodate is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For a Mejiro Umamusume, it's pretty much our backyard.
I mean, who goes sightseeing in their own hometown, right?

Hearing that, it makes sense. If it's practically your hometown,
there's no way you'd get hyped up like a tourist.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still! Thinking back now, maybe my perspective was just too narrow. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with my bestie and Trainer,
the vibes shoot up like crazy, even near my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's ride this wave straight into the Hakodate Kinen!
With this much energy, we might just blast right through it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Palmer-chin, get 'em, get 'em★
Put on an insane race, and the locals are gonna lose their minds!!!
And so, fresh off her sightseeing, Mejiro Palmer marched straight into Hakodate Racecourse.
